title: The Thayer Way
_note: The main story's third chapter (decision 0350): Hardscrabble, from the Stone Lane to Obed joining at the trough. The brief's eight steps (docs/regions/hardscrabble.md, 'The main beat'). Its steps drive the clock: morning on the lane, the wall in the afternoon, the lesson towards evening, and Obed at the trough the next morning.

steps.title: The Stone Lane
steps.objective: The cold has pushed a gap in the lane's north wall. Something has come through it.

hints.text: Stack the gap in the lane's wall, and shut it.

steps.title: Hardscrabble
steps.objective: Go on down the lane into Hardscrabble.

steps.title: Who keeps the walls
steps.objective: Somebody keeps the walls up here. Ask about it.

steps.title: The bad patch
steps.objective: Someone is standing at your patch on the Stone Lane, looking at it.

steps.title: Coyle's wall
steps.objective: Frost is coming down off Hobble Hill. Go up the Sheep Walk and look at Coyle's wall.

steps.title: The pound
steps.objective: Something white is in the stray pound, ramming the walls.

steps.title: The stag at the wall
steps.objective: The stag can't get home through Coyle's wall. Fetch Obed Thayer from his yard.

steps.title: Obed's wall
steps.objective: Obed has gone up Hobble Hill to look at the stag.

steps.title: The wardstone
steps.objective: Put a hand on the wardstone beside Obed's wall.

steps.title: The lesson
steps.objective: Obed is waiting at your patch on the Stone Lane.

steps.title: Morning
steps.objective: Obed is at the trough, with his sledge and a sack.
